text:
GTA 6 officially launches next month.

Here is how to stay alive until November 19:

- Look both ways before crossing the road
- Wear your seatbelt
- Don’t text and drive
- Stay away from random fights
- Don’t climb anything you can fall off
- Don’t eat anything suspicious
- Get enough sleep
- Drink water
- Avoid doing anything that starts with “watch this”
- Absolutely no “one last crazy thing before GTA 6”

We’ve made it this far. Don’t fumble the final month… please.
